turns.question: It's 12 October 2026. What are our sales in Germany so far this month?
turns.answer: "Sales" can mean gross or net, so here are both for customers in Germany, 1 to 12 October 2026: revenue (gross, non-cancelled orders) is 533.75 EUR, and net revenue (revenue minus partner returns) is 494.00 EUR. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
